steps.title: Organize a trip, day by day
steps.body:
KTravel turns a trip into **days, stops, and places**, with the map and route alongside.

Add a place, put it on a day, and see what the actual route between two stops looks like.

steps.title: A log you can read
steps.body:
While it works, the app writes a **local log**: what it did and what failed.

You can find it under *Settings → Diagnostics*, save it to a file, and attach it to a report. It is kept for three days, and you decide how many.

steps.title: Where your trips are stored
steps.body: In short, in three points. Tap one to open the privacy policy exactly where it talks about it.

details.title: Your trips stay on this device
details.body:
Places, days, notes, and attachments are stored in a local database. No account, no servers of ours — and they only leave the device when you export them.

Section **1.1**, in full.

details.title: Third parties involved in the app
details.body: Map tiles, Routing calculation via HERE, crash reports — who is involved is described in this section

details.title: Diagnostics only starts if you say so
details.body: Nothing is sent automatically before you answer the next question, and you can change your mind at any time.

steps.title: Send diagnostics?
steps.body: You can allow the app to send **crash reports and diagnostic logs** to the developer, so an error can be seen without you having to describe it.
